about-p1: Hello there! My name is Abel. And I'm the person behind Anomaly Works. I'm currently immersed in the world of indie game development.
w-11-p-0: The State of Nowhere is a casual simulation game that I developed entirely on my own. During its development I was in charge of writing its story, designing its graphics, composing its sound effects and music, as well as programming every corner of the game. Everything has been elaborated from scratch with a lot of effort and dedication. Its release is scheduled for 2025 for Windows, Mac and Linux initially.
w-11-p-1: You can find more information about this project on my personal <0>Twitter</0> account.
w-11-p-2: You got a job in the food distribution center of the state of Nowhere! Country whose new authorities seek to subdue the population under their rule, severely restricting access to food.
w-11-p-3: The state will equip your workstation with the necessary tools to perform your duties as employee 100411.
w-11-p-4: It will be your duty to carry out the controls that the state deems necessary to keep the population in line.
w-11-p-5: Under the new food reorganization program, you must strictly adhere to the regulations if you want to avoid facing the consequences.
w-11-p-6: All those employees who serve the state exceptionally will be blessed by our honorable president, Maligno.
w-41-p-1: A sample viewer that allows you to compare samples, scale them, apply filters, browse for patterns and make indications on them, among other functions.
w-42-p-1: A program to reflect in a clearer and more organized way the donations data of the Neverwinter game log. It also allows to perform different types of searches
